about.title: About the App
about.referenceToolDesc: This application is designed as a companion tool for Indian citizens to explore government schemes and perform financial projections.
about.dataAccuracyDesc: We strive to provide the most accurate and up-to-date information for 2026. However, interest rates and scheme rules change frequently.
about.officialSourcesDesc: All calculations and scheme details are based on publicly available data from official portals like india.gov.in, npsc.gov.in, etc.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.sec1Body: The results provided by our calculators are estimates based on standard financial formulas and are for informational purposes only. Actual bank or government figures may vary.
termsOfService.sec2Body: This app does not provide professional financial, legal, or tax advice. Users are encouraged to consult with qualified professionals before making significant financial decisions.
termsOfService.sec3Body: While we provide details of government schemes, we are NOT an official government entity. Always verify details on official portals (e.g., .gov.in domains) as rules are subject to change.
termsOfService.sec4Body: FinCalix shall not be liable for any financial losses or decisions made based on the data provided within this application.
termsOfService.acceptance: By using this app, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined above.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.heroDesc: FinCalix collects zero personal data. No backend, no database, no server-side storage. Everything stays on your device.
privacyPolicy.sec1Desc: FinCalix does NOT collect any personal information whatsoever.
privacyPolicy.sec1Li1: No name, email address, phone number, or postal address is collected
privacyPolicy.sec1Li2: No financial data (salary, investments, EMI amounts) is collected
privacyPolicy.sec1Li3: No account creation or login is required to use the app
privacyPolicy.sec1Li4: No user profiles are created or stored
privacyPolicy.sec1End: You can open the app and start calculating instantly — we never ask for any personal details.
privacyPolicy.sec2Desc: FinCalix stores the following data locally on your device only using your browser's LocalStorage:
privacyPolicy.sec2Li1: Calculation inputs — Numbers you enter in calculators
privacyPolicy.sec2Li2: Recently used calculators — For quick access on the home screen
privacyPolicy.sec2Li3: Saved calculations — When you manually save a result
privacyPolicy.sec2BoxTitle: 🔒 This data stays on your device permanently until you:
privacyPolicy.sec2BoxLi1: Clear the app data from your device settings
privacyPolicy.sec2BoxEnd: We have absolutely zero access to this data. It never leaves your device and is never synced to any server.
privacyPolicy.sec3Desc: We use limited analytics (Firebase Analytics) to understand app usage and improve performance. No personal or financial data is ever collected.
privacyPolicy.sec3End: All analytics data is fully anonymous and cannot be linked to any individual.
privacyPolicy.sec4Desc: FinCalix uses the following third-party service for analytics:
privacyPolicy.gaDesc: Anonymous usage statistics only. No personal data is transmitted.
privacyPolicy.vercelDesc: All calculations happen 100% on your device. No API calls. No cloud sync. No data transmission of any kind.
privacyPolicy.sec4End: No advertising networks, tracking pixels, or data-selling services are used.
privacyPolicy.sec5Li1: All numbers you enter (salary, EMI, tax inputs, SIP amounts, etc.) are processed entirely on your device
privacyPolicy.sec5Li2: We never see, store, or transmit your financial figures
privacyPolicy.sec5Li3: All calculations happen in your browser/app — not on any server
privacyPolicy.sec5Li4: There is no backend or API that receives your data
privacyPolicy.sec6P1: FinCalix is designed for users 18 years of age and above. The app contains financial calculators intended for adult use (tax planning, loan EMI, investment returns, etc.).
privacyPolicy.sec6P2: We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18 years of age. Since we collect no personal data at all, there is no risk of children's data being stored.
privacyPolicy.sec7Desc: Since FinCalix stores nothing on any server, there is no server-side data breach risk.
privacyPolicy.sec7Li1: Your data security equals your device security
privacyPolicy.sec7Li2: All web traffic uses HTTPS encryption
privacyPolicy.sec7Li3: We recommend using a device lock screen (PIN, fingerprint, face unlock) to protect your locally stored data
privacyPolicy.accessDesc: All your data is visible directly in the app (Saved Calculations, History, Preferences).
privacyPolicy.deleteDesc: Clear app data from your device settings, or simply uninstall the app. All data is removed instantly.
privacyPolicy.portabilityDesc: We cannot delete data on your behalf because we never had it. You have full control.
privacyPolicy.sec9P1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the 'Last Updated' date at the top of this page.
privacyPolicy.sec9P2: Continued use of FinCalix after changes to this policy constitutes acceptance of the updated terms. We encourage you to review this page periodically.
privacyPolicy.sec10Desc: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, feel free to reach out:
privacyPolicy.viewDataSafety: View Data & Privacy (Play Store Data Safety)
privacyPolicy.sec11Desc: We use analytics tools to understand app usage and improve performance. These tools may change over time, but we ensure no personal or financial data is collected.
privacyPolicy.sec11BoxLi1: All calculations are performed locally on your device.
privacyPolicy.sec11BoxLi2: No financial data is stored on our servers.

term.title: Pure Term Insurance
term.what: Pays the death benefit only. Zero maturity payout.
term.note: For every 1Cr of protection, pure term costs 6,000-18,000/year. This is the most cost-efficient life cover available. Invest the premium savings in mutual funds via SIP.

trop.title: Term + Return of Premium (TROP)
trop.what: Pays all premiums back if you survive the full policy term.
trop.note: You get your premiums back, but the effective return is only 2.5-4% XIRR — below inflation and below FD rates. Better than Endowment. Choose only if you cannot tolerate paying for pure term.

endowment.title: Endowment / Money Back Plan
endowment.what: A mix of life insurance + guaranteed savings.
endowment.maturity: Lower than premiums paid in real terms
endowment.note: You pay 6-8x more premium than term for the same cover. Returns are below Fixed Deposit rates. Classic trap: mixing insurance with investment destroys both. Use term + SIP instead.

ulip.title: ULIP (Market-Linked Plan)
ulip.what: Life insurance combined with a market-linked investment fund.
ulip.xirr: 7%-11% if equity performs; high charges in years 1-5
ulip.note: ULIPs can generate decent returns over 15+ years if equity performs. But high charges in years 1-5 significantly reduce real XIRR. Better alternative for most: pure term + separate ELSS SIP.

checklist.roomRentBody: Ensure the plan has NO sub-limit on room rent. A plan capping room rent at 5,000/day in a metro hospital means ALL linked charges (doctor fees, nursing, procedures) are also proportionally reduced. Avoid any plan with room rent sub-limits.
checklist.restorationBody: After one member uses up the sum insured, it should automatically restore — either once per year or unlimited. This is critical for families where multiple members may need hospitalisation. Ask: Does restoration apply to the same illness or a different illness? Unlimited is better.
checklist.ncbBody: Every claim-free year should increase your sum insured by 10-50% at no extra cost. Check: 1) What % NCB per year? 2) Is NCB protected after a small claim? 3) What is the maximum NCB cap? (50% is good, 100% is excellent)
checklist.pedBody: IRDAI 2025 rules: maximum PED waiting period is now 36 months (3 years) for new policies. Shorter is better. Look for plans with 36-month or less PED waiting. After the waiting period, your pre-existing conditions must be covered. Never hide a pre-existing condition — it is the #1 cause of claim rejection.
checklist.renewBody: Under IRDAI HIR 2016 Regulation 12, any policy renewed without a break cannot be denied renewal due to age. Ensure the policy explicitly states Lifelong Renewable. Never let your health policy lapse — you lose accumulated waiting period credits.
checklist.csrBody: CSR = claims settled / claims received x 100. Look for CSR above 95%. Verify from IRDAI's official annual report at irdai.gov.in — not from broker or comparison websites. Also check the Complaint Volume per 10,000 claims — lower complaints = smoother process.
checklist.tpaBody: Insurers that process claims in-house (no Third Party Administrator) typically settle faster and with fewer disputes. When buying, ask the insurer: Who processes my cashless claims at the hospital? In-house = better.
checklist.seniorBody: Adding parents 60+ to a family floater increases premium for the entire family. Consider a dedicated senior citizen plan. Compare: family floater vs separate senior plan pricing.
checklist.infantBody: Verify the insurer's newborn clause: Is the baby auto-covered from birth? Do you need to inform within 90 days? Is there an extra premium for adding the child?
checklist.floaterBody: Family floaters assume not all members claim in the same year. With 5+ members, the probability of multiple claims increases. Consider buying individual covers for high-risk members (seniors, those with pre-existing conditions) and keeping the floater only for younger, healthy members. Get quotes for both structures.
checklist.newbornCoverBody: Newborns should be covered from Day 1 or within 90 days without a fresh waiting period. Check the exact newborn clause in the policy wording document — not the brochure.
checklist.vaccineBody: Some plans cover routine vaccinations under OPD benefit. Check if this is included or available as an add-on. Useful for families with young children.
checklist.seniorCopayBody: Many plans add a co-payment clause for members above 60 — meaning you pay 10-20% of every claim. This defeats the purpose of insurance for seniors. Look specifically for plans with ZERO co-payment regardless of age.
checklist.seniorSeparateBody: Including parents above 60 in a family floater raises the entire family's premium significantly. Often it is cheaper to buy a dedicated senior citizen plan for parents and keep the main family floater for younger members. Get quotes both ways from IRDAI-registered insurers before deciding.
checklist.elderlyBody: Above age 70, very few insurers accept new proposals. If a parent has an existing policy, NEVER let it lapse — renewal cannot be denied under IRDAI rules. If no existing policy, check IRDAI's list of senior-friendly products at irdai.gov.in.
checklist.pedDeclareBody: Disclose ALL pre-existing conditions accurately in your proposal form. Under IRDAI's moratorium period rules (5 years as of 2024), after 5 years of continuous coverage, your insurer CANNOT reject claims citing non-disclosure (except proven fraud). Never hide conditions — claims get rejected at the worst time.
checklist.siWarnBody: In metro cities, a single surgery with ICU stay costs 3-8 lakhs on average. A cardiac bypass or cancer treatment can cost 8-20 lakhs. 5L cover is inadequate for metro hospitals. Consider 15-25L minimum for families in Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad.

irdaiRights.noAgeTitle: No Age Limit for New Policies
irdaiRights.noAgeBody: Insurers cannot deny new health insurance based on age. (IRDAI 2025 guideline)
irdaiRights.pedWaitBody: Waiting period for pre-existing diseases capped at 36 months for new policies. (IRDAI 2025)
irdaiRights.lifetimeBody: No policy can be denied renewal due to age if renewed without break. (IRDAI HIR 2016 Reg 12)
irdaiRights.moratoriumBody: After 5 years continuous coverage, insurer cannot reject claims citing non-disclosure (except fraud). (IRDAI Master Circular 2024)
irdaiRights.renewCapBody: Insurers cannot increase renewal premium for policyholders above 65 by more than 10% per year. (IRDAI Circular January 2025)
irdaiRights.freeLookBody: You can return the policy within 30 days for a full refund if unsatisfied. (IRDAI free-look rule)
irdaiRights.cashlessBody: Emergency cashless treatment allowed even at non-network hospitals. (IRDAI initiative 2024)
irdaiRights.gstBody: Individual health insurance premiums are GST exempt from September 22, 2025. (56th GST Council)
irdaiRights.portabilityBody: Switch insurer without losing accrued waiting period benefits. Apply 45 days before renewal.
irdaiRights.ombudsmanBody: Free dispute resolution if claim is rejected. File at irdai.gov.in — no lawyer needed.

howToBuy.step1Body: Before comparing premiums, decide your sum insured. Rule of thumb: 1 year of gross income OR minimum 10L for Tier 2/3, 15-25L for metro. Medical inflation is 14%/year in India — choose a sum insured that will still be adequate in 10 years.
howToBuy.step2Body: Go to irdai.gov.in → Statistics → Annual Report. Check Claim Settlement Ratio and Complaint Volume per 10,000 claims. Focus on insurers with CSR above 95% AND complaint ratio below 20.
howToBuy.step3Title: Read the Policy Wording — not the brochure
howToBuy.step3Body: The brochure shows benefits. The Policy Wording Document shows exclusions, sub-limits, and conditions. Search for: room rent, co-pay, sub-limit, waiting period, restoration. These are your risk areas.
howToBuy.step4Title: Get quotes for the same sum insured from 3 insurers
howToBuy.step4Body: Visit 3 insurer websites directly and get quotes for identical sum insured and members. Do not compare a 10L plan from one insurer with a 5L plan from another.
howToBuy.step5Title: Check network hospitals in your city
howToBuy.step5Body: Visit the insurer's website directly and search your preferred hospital name in their network. Do not rely on broker sites for this check — hospital lists change frequently.
howToBuy.step6Title: Buy directly from the insurer website
howToBuy.step6Body: Buying directly (insurer website or app) is cheaper than through a broker — no commission loading. You can still use a broker for advice, but buy direct to avoid markup.
howToBuy.step7Body: Fill the proposal form yourself. Disclose all pre-existing conditions, past surgeries, family medical history. Non-disclosure = claim rejection at the worst possible time.

lifeFacts.f1: Free-look period: 30 days to return the policy for a full refund
lifeFacts.f2: Grace period: 30 days for premium payment before the policy lapses
lifeFacts.f3: Revival: A lapsed policy can be revived within 5 years by paying arrears + interest
lifeFacts.f4: Nomination: Always nominate a beneficiary — mandatory under the Insurance Act
lifeFacts.f5: Assignment: Policy can be assigned to a bank as collateral for a loan
lifeFacts.f6: Suicide clause: After 12 months of policy, death by suicide is also covered
lifeFacts.f7: IRDAI Ombudsman: Free dispute resolution at irdai.gov.in if a claim is rejected
